title: LANSING REPORT PRIOR — toss the rank. braid the error.
note: city-level only. no street. home city as public locus.

heard.claim: Lansing is the 7th most dangerous city in the country
heard.kind: folk / headline costume. ranks shuffle by year, cutoff, vendor.
heard.berry: 7th is a story people tell. the number moves. dig the METHOD, not the medal.

BUT.asymmetry: Lansing REPORTS its stats. many peers INFER, estimate, delay, or under-submit.
BUT.punishment: honest reporters look worse on the same table. under-reporters look safer.

evidence_pattern.MLive_2026_note: FBI UCR regularly differs — sometimes substantially — from year-end numbers local agencies publish. Flint FBI figures sat far below Flint PD December totals; using PD totals would reorder the national table.
evidence_pattern.read: the rank is not ground. the rank is a costume on incomplete submission.

inference_vs_report.reported: agency counted and filed. error still exists (definition, timing, geography) but the count is owned.
inference_vs_report.inferred: gap-filled, estimated, lagged, or missing. looks smooth. hides variance.
inference_vs_report.table_lie: treating both as the same certainty is the crime against the data.

method.name: toss → teach → backscatter → prior → refire with error

steps.do: throw the certainty claim on the table. do not defend the medal.
trace HOW the number was made: who reported, who estimated, what population cutoff, which year, which Part I bag.
bounce to the raw / local / agency layer. compare FBI row to PD year-end. name the delta.
use priors as BASELINES you refire toward — not as the answer. reporting-completeness prior, city-size prior, definition prior.
publish rate ± error. work at the statistical error points. never ship CERTAINTY.

priors_as_baselines.are: starting seats you update when backscatter returns

examples.baseline: Michigan MSP → FBI pipeline has known lag / tech / method gaps
absence of crime in the table ≠ absence of crime
examples.update_when: peer has partial UCR months or silent years

error_is_the_work.surface: statistical error points — where variance / missingness / definition clash
error_is_the_work.yes: error bars, completeness flags, inferred-vs-reported tags on every peer
error_is_the_work.court: only NULL-kind waste gets sued. incomplete data is FEED — chew it, do not crown it.

strands: klein-sieve: entropy of missing months vs chaos of headline ranks
waste-category: inferred-as-certain is null-kind if it crowns a city
order-dam: nominal set of cities ≠ ordered danger medals without shared completeness

berry_at_the_fire: heard Lansing is 7th most dangerous? BUT dig: Lansing reports; others get inferred. same table, different certainty costumes. toss the medal. teach the pipeline. backscatter to the counts. priors are baselines you refire with. work the error. never CERTAINTY.
next: when anyone cites a city danger rank, demand: reported or inferred? completeness? ±error? if missing, hold the medal at the dam.

expand.do: all US states+cities → ~400y curves → world bounce → appleSeed walkers circumnavigate
